arxiv-1505-07510.title: Comment on ”Tetraquarks as diquark-antidiquark bound systems”
arxiv-1505-07510.creator: M. R. Hadizadeh
arxiv-1505-07510.description: Abstract The author argues that the calculated masses of heavy tetraquarks obtained by solution of the spin-independent homogeneous Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation in a diquark-antidiquark picture reported by M. Monemzadeh et al., Phys. Lett. B 741 , 124 (2015), are incorrect.

arxiv-1707-06878.title: Unsupervised, Knowledge-Free, and Interpretable Word Sense Disambiguation
arxiv-1707-06878.creator: Alexander Panchenko, Fide Marten, Eugen Ruppert, Stefano Faralli, Dmitry Ustalov, Simone Paolo Ponzetto, Chris Biemann
arxiv-1707-06878.description: Abstract Interpretability of a predictive model is a powerful feature that gains the trust of users in the correctness of the predictions. In word sense disambiguation (WSD), knowledge-based systems tend to be much more interpretable than knowledge-free counterparts as they rely on the wealth of manually-encoded elements representing word senses, such as hypernyms, usage examples, and images.

arxiv-2101-04778.title: SYNTHETIC LIGHT CURVES OF ACCRETION VARIABILITY IN T TAURI STARS
arxiv-2101-04778.creator: Connor E. Robinson, Catherine C. Espaillat, James E. Owen
arxiv-2101-04778.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Connor E. Robinson, Catherine C. Espaillat, James E. Owen. Photometric observations of accreting, low-mass, pre-main-sequence stars (i.e., Classical T Tauri stars; CTTS) have revealed different categories of variability. Several of these classifications have been linked to changes in M ˙ \dot{M} . To test how accretion variability conditions lead to different light-curve morphologies, we used 1D hydrodynamic simulations of accretion along a magnetic field line coupled with radiative transfer models and a simple treatment of rotation to generate synthetic light curves.

arxiv-2105-01548.title: Loop representation of Quantum Gravity
arxiv-2105-01548.creator: Adrian P. C. Lim
arxiv-2105-01548.description: Abstract A hyperlink is a finite set of non-intersecting simple closed curves in ℝ 4 ≡ ℝ × ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{4}\equiv{{\mathbb{R}}}\times{{\mathbb{R}}}^{3} , each curve is either a matter or geometric loop. We consider an equivalence class of such hyperlinks, up to time-like isotopy, preserving time-ordering.

arxiv-2209-08760.title: On the range of the X X -ray transform of symmetric tensors compactly supported in the plane
arxiv-2209-08760.creator: Kamran Sadiq, Alexandru Tamasan
arxiv-2209-08760.description: Abstract . We find the necessary and sufficient conditions on the Fourier coefficients of a function g g on the torus to be in the range of the X X -ray transform of a symmetric tensor of compact support in the plane. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 44A12, 35J56; Secondary 45E05 1.

arxiv-2305-13105.title: Quasi-actions whose quasi-orbits are quasi-isometric to trees
arxiv-2305-13105.creator: J. O. Button
arxiv-2305-13105.description: Abstract We give necessary and sufficient conditions under which a quasi-action of any group on an arbitrary metric space can be reduced to a cobounded isometric action on some bounded valence tree, following a result of Mosher, Sageev and Whyte. Moreover if the quasi-action is metrically proper and quasi-orbits are quasi-isometric to trees then the group is virtually free.

arxiv-2312-12317.title: Full-reference Video Quality Assessment for User Generated Content Transcoding Thanks: The authors thank the funding from Tencent (US), University of Bristol, and the UKRI MyWorld Strength in Places Programme (SIPF00006/1).
arxiv-2312-12317.creator: Zihao Qi † , Chen Feng † , Duolikun Danier † , Fan Zhang † , Xiaozhong Xu § , Shan Liu § and David Bull †
arxiv-2312-12317.description: Abstract Unlike video coding for professional content, the delivery pipeline of User Generated Content (UGC) involves transcoding where unpristine reference content needs to be compressed repeatedly. In this work, we observe that existing full-/no-reference quality metrics fail to accurately predict the perceptual quality difference between transcoded UGC content and the corresponding unpristine references.

arxiv-2403-11317.title: Few-Shot VQA with Frozen LLMs: A Tale of Two Approaches
arxiv-2403-11317.creator: Igor Sterner, Weizhe Lin, Jinghong Chen, Bill Byrne
arxiv-2403-11317.description: Abstract Two approaches have emerged to input images into large language models (LLMs). The first is to caption images into natural language. The second is to map image feature embeddings into the domain of the LLM and pass the mapped embeddings directly to the LLM.

arxiv-2410-13759.title: On the practicality of quantum sieving algorithms for the shortest vector problem
arxiv-2410-13759.creator: Joao F. Doriguello, George Giapitzakis, Alessandro Luongo, Aditya Morolia
arxiv-2410-13759.description: Abstract One of the main candidates of post-quantum cryptography is lattice-based cryptography. Its cryptographic security against quantum attackers is based on the worst-case hardness of lattice problems like the shortest vector problem (SVP), which asks to find the shortest non-zero vector in an integer lattice. Asymptotic quantum speedups for solving SVP are known and rely on Grover’s search.

arxiv-2501-12449.title: Intervening nuclear obscuration changing the X-ray look of the z ≈ 6 z\approx 6 quasi-stellar object CFHQS J164121+375520
arxiv-2501-12449.creator: F. Vito, W. N. Brandt, A. Comastri, R. Gilli, F. Bauer, S. Belladitta, G. Chartas, K. Iwasawa, G. Lanzuisi, B. Luo, S. Marchesi, M. Mignoli, F. Ricci, O. Shemmer, C. Spingola, C. Vignali, W. Boschin, F. Cusano, D. Paris
arxiv-2501-12449.description: Abstract X-ray observations of the optically selected z = 6.025 z=6.025 quasi-stellar object (QSO) CFHQS J164121+375520 (hereafter J1641) revealed that its flux dropped by a factor of ≳ 7 \gtrsim 7 between 2018, when it was a bright and soft X-ray source, and 2021.

arxiv-2503-12515.title: AI-Powered Automated Model Construction for Patient-Specific CFD Simulations of Aortic Flows
arxiv-2503-12515.creator: Pan Du, Delin An, Chaoli Wang, Jian-Xun Wang
arxiv-2503-12515.description: Abstract Image-based modeling is essential for understanding cardiovascular hemodynamics and advancing the diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases. Constructing patient-specific vascular models remains labor-intensive, error-prone, and time-consuming, limiting their clinical applications. This study introduces a deep-learning framework that automates the creation of simulation-ready vascular models from medical images.

pmc-10672423.title: MR-Guided Focused Ultrasound for Refractory Epilepsy: Where Are We Now?
pmc-10672423.creator: Angelo Labate, Salvatore Bertino, Rosa Morabito, Chiara Smorto, Annalisa Militi, Simona Cammaroto, Carmelo Anfuso, Francesco Tomaiuolo, Paolo Tonin, Silvia Marino, Antonio Cerasa, Angelo Quartarone, Emanuele Bartolini
pmc-10672423.description: Epilepsy is one of the most common neurological diseases in both adults and children. Despite improvements in medical care, 20 to 30% of patients are still resistant to the best medical treatment. The quality of life, neurologic morbidity, and even mortality of patients are significantly impacted by medically intractable epilepsy.

pmc-11355938.title: Effects of Environmental Conditions on Athlete’s Cardiovascular System
pmc-11355938.creator: Andrea Segreti, Mihail Celeski, Emiliano Guerra, Simone Pasquale Crispino, Francesca Vespasiano, Lorenzo Buzzelli, Chiara Fossati, Rocco Papalia, Fabio Pigozzi, Francesco Grigioni
pmc-11355938.description: Environmental factors such as extreme temperatures, humidity, wind, pollution, altitude, and diving can significantly impact athletes’ cardiovascular systems, potentially hindering their performance, particularly in outdoor sports. The urgency of this issue is heightened by the increasing prevalence of climate change and its associated conditions, including fluctuating pollution levels, temperature variations, and the spread of infectious diseases.

pmc-11369128.title: CD24 affects the immunosuppressive effect of tumor-infiltrating cells and tumor resistance in a variety of cancers
pmc-11369128.creator: Chunmei Zhao, Ying Huang, Haotian Zhang, Huimin Liu
pmc-11369128.description: BackgroundCluster of differentiation 24 (CD24) is a highly glycosylated glycosylphosphatidylinositol (GPI)-anchored surface protein, expressed in various tumor cells, as a "don't eat me" signaling molecule in tumor immune. This study aimed to investigate the potential features of CD24 in pan-cancer.MethodsThe correlations between 22 immune cells and CD24 expression were using TIMER analysis.

pmc-11424953.title: Optimal fermentation conditions for growth and recombinant protein production in Pichia pastoris: Strain selection, ploidy level and carbon source
pmc-11424953.creator: Paz Shemesh, Ayelet Fishman
pmc-11424953.description: High-cell-density fermentation is a critical aspect of industrial protein production, requiring the selection of an optimal growth medium and carbon source. Pichia pastoris, a methylotrophic yeast, has been established as a widespread recombinant protein expression system in the food and pharmaceutical industries.

pmc-13073146.title: Effects of small-scale temperature shifts on Aedes mosquito production and the influence of environmental conditions on quality assessment with the FAO/IAEA flight test device
pmc-13073146.creator: Wadaka Mamai, Hamidou Maiga, Odet Bueno-Masso, Thomas Wallner, Nanwintoum Sévérin Bimbile Somda, Simran Singh Kotla, Thabo Mashatola, Hanano Yamada, Chantel Janet de Beer, Jérémy Bouyer
pmc-13073146.description: Variations in environmental parameters such as temperature and relative humidity (RH) can significantly affect mass-rearing outcomes and quality assessment. While the impact of broad temperature changes is well documented, the effects of small-scale fluctuations (1–2 °C shifts) on development and quality remain largely unexplored.

pmc-13387315.title: Allosteric interactions between RyR channels justify intracellular Ca2+ release of skeletal muscle in quantitative detail
pmc-13387315.creator: Eduardo Rios, Gonzalo Pizarro
pmc-13387315.description: The contraction of skeletal muscles is turned on by Ca2+ released from the cellular store by RyR channels in a quasi-crystalline array, half of which only have contacts with neighbor RyRs. Rios and Pizarro’s model assumes these channels to be controlled allosterically by their neighbors and matches quantitatively observations of Ca2+ release gathered over decades.

pmc-13483031.title: Non-thermal plasma treatment as a sustainable approach for wastewater reuse in hydroponic cultivation of Lactuca Sativa
pmc-13483031.creator: Ludmila Čechová, Plamena Marinova, Evgenia Benova, Yovana Todorova, Ivaylo Yotinov, Yana Topalova, Jakub Buday, Pavel Pořízka, Jozef Kaiser, Todor Bogdanov
pmc-13483031.description: The challenge in developing modern agricultural practices is to reduce irrigation water use, identify alternative water sources, improve plant growth, increase crop yields, and, finally, reduce the use of synthetic fertilizers and pesticides. Plasma treatment and wastewater decontamination may enable the safe reuse of nutrient-rich water in agriculture.
